metadata.name: Photo Review Form
metadata.description: A review form with a half-star rating control (mouse, touch, arrow keys, Home, End, digits) where stars light up in a wave with sparks. Photos drop onto a desk with a bouncy spring, can be reordered by dragging, and fly off when removed.
metadata.author: vovalopuh13
